title: Trump STUNNED as Canada & EU UNITE - US Reversal on Russia BACKFIRES
speaker: Sean Foo

macro_themes.view: September CPI 3.7% and PPI 6.3% signal a 2022-style inflation wave that will squeeze consumers and profits and push rate hikes.
Ukraine's refinery strikes and possible escalation against Iran after the midterms could lock down Hormuz and push oil and inflation higher.
Rising chip costs, higher rates and falling data-center bonds threaten an AI buildout priced to perfection; inflation is the crack.

macro_themes.theme: Europe energy crisis and Canada pivot
macro_themes.view: EU gas at triple pre-war levels drives debt stress (France) and pushes Europe toward energy partnerships with Canada, hurting US LNG.
China won't buy US bonds while the dollar is weaponized; the yuan is gaining share in trade finance as RMB strengthens.

calls.condition: if Ukraine strikes continue / Trump escalates on Iran (MOABs) after midterms
calls.reason: Refinery strikes remove Russian barrels and an Iran escalation could close Hormuz and the Red Sea, sending oil up again.
calls.quote: We can all imagine Hormuz and the entire Red Sea getting locked down... Oil could jump again, and inflation, it's going to follow.

calls.reason: PPI at 6.3% foreshadows consumer inflation and more Fed hikes; China not buying Treasuries.
calls.quote: bond yields, they might be dropping a bit today, but they could go much higher if nothing changes.

calls.reason: China avoids dollar assets while the dollar is weaponized; yuan gaining share in trade finance and RMB up 7% vs USD.
calls.quote: China has a thousand and one things to buy, dollars are not one of them.

calls.reason: Higher chip prices and borrowing costs plus collapsing data-center bonds threaten an AI buildout priced to perfection.
calls.quote: Stock prices and AI bonds, they're all priced to perfection... A single miss can trigger a sell-off. Inflation is that crack.

notes: Geopolitical/macro commentary with no price levels. SMH used as a proxy for his generic 'US chip companies' and AI-bond bearishness. DXY bias rests mainly on RMB/de-dollarization comments.
